description: Source code for a graphics rendering program, specifically a class 'Program' that manages OpenGL shader programs for rendering textures in an Android environment.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: A class managing OpenGL shader programs for rendering textures, supporting external and 2D textures, with methods for setup, rendering, and resource management.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the shader program based on the specified type (external or 2D texture).

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Compiles vertex and fragment shaders and links them into a shader program.

methods.name: compileShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of given type from source code.

methods.name: linkShaderProgram
methods.description: Links compiled vertex and fragment shaders into a shader program.

methods.name: blit
methods.description: Renders a textured rectangle at specified position and size.

methods.name: drawTriangles
methods.description: Draws triangles with specified vertices and texture coordinates.

methods.name: beforeDraw
methods.description: Prepares OpenGL state for drawing, setting matrices and binding textures.
